The '''stealth ship''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] prototype [[Starship/Legends|starship]] designed to help aid the war effort during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Description==
[[File:Stealth_ship_cloaking.png|thumb|left|200px|A prototype of the stealth ship's cloak activating]]
The stealth ship was an experimental [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] equipped with a [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking device]], which allowed the ship to become completely invisible to the naked [[Eye/Legends|eye]], and almost completely invisible to every [[scanner]]. The ship featured a multi-segmented main fuselage, mid-section antenna array, upper and lower [[Anti-aircraft cannon/Legends|anti-aircraft]] dual [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] [[Turret/Legends|turrets]], four [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedo]] launchers, and a large [[Engine/Legends|engine]] pod at the tail. It also had a two-man crewed countermeasures compartment, and the capacity to carry extra [[Troop/Legends|troops]] and cargo.

==History==
{{Quote|It's a pretty small ship to destroy a whole fleet. Are there more?''"<br />"''No. This is the prototype, and you ''won't'' be on the offensive. I need you to run a mercy mission down to the planet surface.|Anakin Skywalker and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="Cat and Mouse" />}}
A prototype stealth ship was introduced by [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] at the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]]. Although its objective was to continue the mercy mission to [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]] undetected, [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] decided to attack the [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]]. It was used against [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Trench/Legends|Trench]] during the breaking of the orbital blockade around the planet. [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]], [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Blackout/Legends|Blackout]], and [[Spark/Legends|Spark]] were also present on the prototype ship.<ref name="Cat and Mouse" />

==Behind the scenes==
In the episode when [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] states that it is unusual for a [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|smaller ship]] to have a [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking device]], which is a reference to a line from [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']] by [[Lorth Needa/Legends|Lorth Needa]]. The Stealth Ship concept, alongside the entire premise of their debut episode, [[Cat and Mouse]], was based on Submarine Warfare from World War II.<ref name="From World War to Star Wars: Spaceships, Submarines, and Seismic Charges">{{SW|url=news/from-world-war-to-star-wars-spaceships-submarines-and-seismic-charges|text=From World War to ''Star Wars'': Spaceships, Submarines and Seismic Charges|int=From World War to Star Wars|nolive=1}}</ref>
